original:
ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय ।
यश्चराचरस्रष्टा च पालयिता च यः प्रभुः ।
संहर्ता च जगन्नाथस्तस्मै विष्ण्वात्मने नमः ॥
transliteration:
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya |
yaścarācarasraṣṭā ca pālayitā ca yaḥ prabhuḥ |
saṃhartā ca jagannāthastasmai viṣṇvātmane namaḥ ||
translation: Om, salutations unto the Supreme Lord Vasudeva! He who is the creator of the moving and unmoving universe, its sustainer, and its dissolver—salutations unto that Lord of the Universe, Vishnu.
meaning: Achara Khanda Invocation: Opening prayer of the Garuda Purana extolling Lord Vishnu as the supreme cause of the cosmos and the source of all righteousness.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: Dutt notes that the Garuda Purana, revealed by Lord Vishnu to his celestial mount Garuda, opens with a comprehensive invocation defining Vishnu as the eternal source of cosmic order.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: गरुड़पुराण के आचार खण्ड का यह मंगलाचरण भगवान श्रीहरि विष्णु के सर्वव्यापी और कृपालु स्वरूप की स्तुति करता है।

original:
वैनतेय उवाच —
भगवन् सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वलोकहिते रतः ।
कथं जीवाः सुखं यान्ति कथं धर्मः प्रजायते ॥
transliteration:
vainateya uvāca —
bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvalokahite rataḥ |
kathaṃ jīvāḥ sukhaṃ yānti kathaṃ dharmaḥ prajāyate ||
translation: Garuda, son of Vinata, said: O Lord, knower of all righteous duty, ever devoted to the welfare of all worlds! How do living beings attain enduring happiness, and how is Dharma established in their hearts?
meaning: Garuda's Sacred Inquiry: The great bird Garuda questions Lord Vishnu on the principles of ethical living, health, and spiritual peace.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: The Achara Khanda deals extensively with astronomy, medicine, statecraft, ethics, and ritual purity, responding to Garuda's questions regarding earthly welfare.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: गरुड़ जी ने जीवों के कल्याण और धर्म के यथार्थ आचरण के विषय में भगवान विष्णु से प्रश्न किया।

original:
श्रीभगवानुवाच —
सत्यं शौचं दया दानं स्वाध्यायः संयमस्तथा ।
अहिंसा च परा शान्तिरेष धर्मः सनातनः ॥
transliteration:
śrībhagavānuvāca —
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā dānaṃ svādhyāyaḥ saṃyamastathā |
ahiṃsā ca parā śāntireṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
translation: The Supreme Lord said: Truthfulness, purity, compassion, charity, self-study of wisdom, sensory restraint, non-violence, and profound inner peace—this is the eternal Dharma (Sanatana Dharma).
meaning: The Essence of Sanatana Dharma: The eight pillars of universal ethical conduct.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: This definition emphasizes moral virtue over mechanical ritualism, presenting ethical righteousness as the necessary prerequisite for divine grace.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: भगवान ने सत्य, दया, दान, अहिंसा और संयम को सनातन धर्म का मूल लक्षण बताया है।

original:
परोपकाराय फलन्ति वृक्षाः परोपकाराय वहन्ति नद्यः ।
परोपकाराय दुहन्ति गावः परोपकारार्थमिदं शरीरम् ॥
transliteration:
paropakārāya phalanti vṛkṣāḥ paropakārāya vahanti nadyaḥ |
paropakārāya duhanti gāvaḥ paropakārārthamidaṃ śarīram ||
translation: Trees bear sweet fruit for the benefit of others; rivers flow for the thirst of others; cows yield milk for the nourishment of others; this human body exists solely for benevolent service unto others.
meaning: Universal Altruism (Paropakara): The supreme duty of the human incarnation is selfless service to all beings.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: This famous verse from the ethical chapters of the Garuda Purana underscores that nature itself teaches altruism as the universal law of existence.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: प्रकृति के समस्त अवयव दूसरों की सेवा में लगे हैं, अतः मनुष्य जीवन का भी सच्चा उद्देश्य परोपकार ही है।

original:
शरीरमाद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनं तस्माद्रक्षेद्यत्नतः ।
आयुर्वेदोदितैर्मागैर्दीर्घमायुः समाप्नुयात् ॥
transliteration:
śarīramādyaṃ khalu dharmasādhanaṃ tasmādrakṣedyatnataḥ |
āyurvedoditairmārgairdīrghamāyuḥ samāpnuyāt ||
translation: Verily, the physical body is the foundational instrument for the practice of Dharma; therefore, one should preserve it with diligence, securing longevity through the noble principles of Ayurveda.
meaning: Holistic Health in Achara Khanda: Garuda Purana's treatise on diet, herbal medicine, and physical wellness.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: The Garuda Purana dedicates dozens of chapters to medicine, therapeutics, and toxicology, considering health the indispensable foundation for spiritual realization.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: शरीर धर्म का पहला साधन है, अतः आयुर्वेद के नियमों का पालन करते हुए स्वास्थ्य की रक्षा करना परम कर्तव्य है।

original:
ज्ञानेन हीनाः पशुभिः समाना धर्मेण युक्ता भुवि मानवाः स्युः ।
तस्मात्प्रयत्नेन विचारशीलो विद्यामवाप्नोतु परोपकाराम् ॥
transliteration:
jñānena hīnāḥ paśubhiḥ samānā dharmeṇa yuktā bhuvi mānavāḥ syuḥ |
tasmātprayatnena vicāraśīlo vidyāmavāplotu paropakārām ||
translation: Bereft of discriminative wisdom, humans are merely equal to animals; adorned with Dharma, they become true human beings. Therefore, with diligent reflection, acquire wisdom dedicated to the common good.
meaning: The Value of Discrimination (Viveka): Education and moral conscience elevate human existence above animal instincts.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: Dutt notes the classic Indian humanistic sentiment: without ethical culture and spiritual inquiry, human life fails to fulfill its unique potential.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: ज्ञान और धर्म ही मनुष्य को पशुत्व से ऊपर उठाकर देवत्व की ओर अग्रसर करते हैं।

original:
मातृवत्परदारेषु परद्रव्येषु लोष्टवत् ।
आत्मवत्सर्वभूतेषु यः पश्यति स पण्डितः ॥
transliteration:
mātṛvatparadāreṣu paradravyeṣu loṣṭavat |
ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu yaḥ paśyati sa paṇḍitaḥ ||
translation: He who looks upon another's spouse as his own mother, upon another's wealth as a mere clod of earth, and upon all living beings as his very own self—he alone is truly wise (a true Pandita).
meaning: The Benchmark of True Wisdom: Universal respect, non-covetousness, and experiencing the self in all creatures.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: This celebrated ethical aphorism encapsulates the highest moral standard of the Puranic tradition, defining scholarship by purity of conduct rather than book learning.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: सच्चा ज्ञानी वही है जो दूसरों की संपत्ति को मिट्टी के समान और सभी प्राणियों को अपनी आत्मा के समान देखता है।

original:
तपसा प्राप्यते स्वर्गो ज्ञानेन लभते पदम् ।
भक्त्या विष्णौ स्थिरां शान्तिं प्राप्नुवन्ति न संशयः ॥
transliteration:
tapasā prāpyate svargo jñānena labhate padam |
bhaktyā viṣṇau sthirāṃ śāntiṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
translation: Through austerity heavenly realms are attained; through knowledge the higher station is reached; but through unwavering devotion unto Lord Vishnu, everlasting peace is realized without doubt.
meaning: The Supremacy of Bhakti: Devotion as the direct conduit to unshakable inner peace and liberation.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: While recognizing ritual austerity and intellectual philosophy, the Garuda Purana concludes that loving devotion to God is the supreme shelter.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: भगवान विष्णु की अनन्य भक्ति से ही जीव को शाश्वत शांति और परम पद की प्राप्ति होती है।

original:
कर्मणा बध्यते जन्तुर्विद्यया तु विमुच्यते ।
तस्मात्कर्म न कुर्वन्ति यतयः पारदर्शिनः ॥
transliteration:
karmaṇā badhyate janturvidyayā tu vimucyate |
tasmātkarma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ ||
translation: By attachment to selfish action a living being is bound; by spiritual wisdom one is liberated. Therefore, the wise seers perform actions without selfish desire, gazing upon the transcendent truth.
meaning: Karma and Jnana Synthesis: Unselfish duty accompanied by spiritual knowledge dissolves the bondage of Samsara.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: Action without spiritual awareness creates rebirth; illuminated action performed as an offering unto God leads directly to liberation.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: अहंकारयुक्त कर्म बंधन का कारण है और निष्काम भाव से किया गया ज्ञानयुक्त कर्म मोक्षदायक है।

original:
नमोऽस्त्वनन्ताय सहस्रमूर्तये सहस्रपादाक्षिशिरोरुबाहवे ।
सहस्रनाम्ने पुरुषाय शाश्वते सहस्रकोटीयुगधारिणे नमः ॥
transliteration:
namo'stvanantāya sahasramūrtaye sahasrapādākṣiśirorubāhave |
sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭīyugadhāriṇe namaḥ ||
translation: Salutations unto the Infinite Supreme Being of a thousand forms, thousand feet, eyes, heads, thighs, and arms! Salutations unto the eternal cosmic Purusha of a thousand sacred names, upholder of millions of cosmic ages!
meaning: The Cosmic Vision (Vishvarupa): Homage to the infinite Purusha concluding the Achara Khanda with Vedic majesty.

layers.author: mn-dutt
layers.content: Echoing the Purusha Sukta (Rigveda 10.90), this magnificent hymn concludes the first section by contemplating the omnipresence of the Divine.

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: अनंत रूपों, अनंत भुजाओं और सहस्त्र युगों को धारण करने वाले विराट् पुरुषोत्तम भगवान विष्णु को बारम्बार प्रणाम।
